objective: Recover correct Pi readiness verdicts and project-instructions backup/restore actions across sealed process traces and filesystem states. Maximize weighted exact recovery; only solution.py is mutable.

meta.provenance: terminal-only bounded readiness and instructions-projection extraction from Harness baseline 1815353f85f8f052fea30812aaca3be485c51d30; reference 39ff71f informed diagnostic direction only

sourceDetails.derivation: bounded exact-output subsystem extracted for isolated deterministic terminal evaluation

measurement.q: weighted exact-recovery fraction over sealed cases (recovered case weight divided by total weight; readiness cases weight 1, projection cases weight 2); trusted per-call timing is diagnostic only and never enters the score
measurement.qBaseSource: frozen baseline artifact measured by the trusted ordering tool under the admitted evaluator (ordering-report variants.baseline.train)
measurement.qReferenceSource: improved diagnostic control, full recovery of every sealed case (ordering-report variants.improved.train); direction informed by reference commit 39ff71f
measurement.normalization: gain = (q - qBase) / scale, with scale = qReference - qBase
